titulo: I thanked the moon. It said: thank yourself, actually.
caption:
Thanksgiving, pointed back at you: why the person you forget to thank is yourself.

I thanked the moon. It said: thank yourself, actually.

Closer to yourself.

White words in the middle read: "I thanked the moon. It said: thank yourself, actually."
